summary: Well-structured multi-layered test suite covering parsing, aggregation, flaky detection, markdown generation, workflow structure, and real CI/CD execution via act. Tests validate exact output values, error handling, and edge cases like empty result sets and defaults. Strengths: unit tests isolate components, workflow tests verify YAML structure and actionlint compliance, act tests run the full pipeline in actual GitHub Actions containers with multiple realistic fixture scenarios. Weaknesses: (1) FailOnTestFailure flag mentioned in implementation but not explicitly tested for exit code 1 behavior; (2) fixture file contents not provided to verify expected test data; (3) test count discrepancy (mentions 27 passed but structured tests total ~34-37); (4) missing edge cases like large suites, concurrent file access, and special characters in test names; (5) act tests are slow (30-90s each) with only 2 cases covering the matrix scenarios. Would catch most regressions but has gaps in feature completeness and fixture transparency.
